newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi man beheaded for killing cousin.
newsitem.headline: Saudi man beheaded for killing cousin.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Saudi man for fatally shooting his cousin for "no reason", raising to 43 the number of people put to death by the sword in the conservative kingdom this year.

Saudi state-run television quoted an Interior Ministry statement as saying Hussein bin Hweil al-Qahtani was executed in the southern province of Aseer after a court found him guilty of killing his male cousin.
Saudi Arabia enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, drug smugglers and rapists.
